text:
incident-bot: P1 pager: spike in /v1/embeddings 5xx + type-mismatch in eu-west-1. error rate 18% over 5m, affected customers: multiple. paging oncall.

Devon O'Neill: I'm oncall, pulling up routing logs now. assigning @Kyle for runtime, @Maya for routing policy.

Kyle Ramos: seeing a lot of responses from embeddings endpoint that look like chat/generation payloads (strings instead of vectors). suspect wrong variant served. sample:```json
{
  "request_id": "r-9a3f",
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "served_model": "redwood-instruct-v1",
  "response": { "type": "text", "content": "The weather today is..." }
}```

Maya Chen: traces show a fallback path kicked in in eu-west-1 at 12:07:22 UTC. primary embed variant (redwood-embed-q4f) failed health checks on a handful of nodes and fallback policy allowed any compatible alias -> landed on instruct-variant. Looks like the alias anchor for the embed alias included an instruct-compatible target by mistake during last release.

Priya Sharma: Customer impact: AcmeMaps / geosearch ingest returned blobs that couldn't be indexed. CS reports degraded search on 3 customers, 1 active SLA window. We need quick mitigation and a customer-facing note.

Devon O'Neill: mitigation idea: short-circuit fallback to reject incompatible interface, and pin embeddings route to verified embed model in eu-west-1. applying temporary override.

Devon O'Neill: running command:```bash
infractl route override set --route embeddings --region eu-west-1 --key fallback_policy --value reject_incompatible
infractl route override set --route embeddings --region eu-west-1 --key pinned_model --value redwood-embed-q4f-stable
```

SRE OnCall: applied both overrides at 12:15:03 UTC. rolling restart of affected pool to clear cached alias mapping.

incident-bot: Override applied by Devon O'Neill. rolling restart initiated. error rate down to 0.9% in last 2m.

Kyle Ramos: confirmed responses now contain vectors. sample:```json
{
  "served_model": "redwood-embed-q4f-stable",
  "response": { "type": "vector", "values": [0.012, -0.34, 0.88] }
}```

Priya Sharma: I told CS to notify impacted customers and that we're issuing a root-cause update shortly. asking Product for final messaging.

Maya Chen: root cause prelim: release anchored alias included a non-embed variant in the allowlist due to a malformed release manifest (alias_targets: [redwood-embed-q4f, redwood-instruct-v1]) — mismatch slipped past verification step. follow-ups: tighten alias vetting in release pipeline, add interface compatibility checks to routing policy evaluation.

Devon O'Neill: creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem. action items: 1) rollback malformed anchor from last release (Maya), 2) add automated interface check to canary (Kyle), 3) customer comms + credit proposal (Priya).

Priya Sharma: CS will send interim note and schedule one-hour follow-up call for impacted accounts.

incident-bot: Metrics stabilized: error rate 0.2% in last 5m after overrides. marking incident as mitigated, P1 -> P2 for postmortem coordination.

Devon O'Neill: handing off to oncall for next 2 hours monitoring, will join postmortem. thanks team :thumbsup:
